items.title: The tip of Nantasket
items.caption: Nantaket beach was remarkable for its wide and flat shore. At the Allerton tip it is exceptionaly rocky but that gives way to expansive sandy flats further towards Atlantic

items.title: Sandy Nantasket Flats
items.caption: The wind blows streaks of sand over the wide beach. This may be the best beach I've seen for skimboarding or soccer

items.title: The ghost of Paragon Park
items.caption: Open from 1905 to 1984 Paragon Park was a jewel set on the shore of Nantasket. Fastforward to today this is the cheap copy propped up to quench the lingering thirst for the whimsy of an amusement park.

items.title: Reflecting on the Greenway
items.caption: I've never known a pre-BigDig Boston, which makes it tough to imagine the city without this snaking green connective tissue that joins together the NorthEnd, Finance-bro-land, and China Town
